_note: ⛔ SNG-410. THE PRECURSOR LINE NETWORK. CCode: 'the precursor lines have no data in our asset — that's the one real authoring ask.' ⚠️ REGENERATED FROM CURRENT CANON, NOT SHIPPED FROM MY SANDBOX. My prototype file held 49 spans built before SNG-407 moved 11 locations; shipping it would have wired the network to where places used to be. ⛔ Reading a stale sandbox copy of a derived layer is how the Millfen happened.
_derivation: Nodes are the substrateSource POOLS only — 33 of 44. A SINK is where the lattice DRAINS, not where a line runs; the Umbrals keep Dusklow low deliberately, and running a relay to it would contradict the reason it is a sink. Spans are a minimum spanning tree over the pools plus the 8 shortest non-tree links under 14°, because a network built to survive has redundancy and a bare tree does not.
_whatItMeans: ⛔ THESE LINES ARE DORMANT. Measured: waygates are only 1.1× closer to substrate sources than chance, and 2 of 26 sit within 3° of one. THE THREE NETWORKS ARE INDEPENDENT — Precursors laid these, someone else built the gates, and people walk neither. ⚠️ That is why `wake_the_line` exists as a craft: you only rouse a road nobody has been using. And it is why `gen-watershed-road` is canon — a player found a live relay chain 'south to the mill gate and north toward the ridge', which is one of these spans still carrying.
_rendering: Straight great-circle arcs, drawn BELOW the surface radius — they run under the ground, not on it. ⚠️ They should be revealed by the `old_roads` craft, not shown by default: 'sense, follow, and safely approach Precursor traces.'
_independenceMeasured:
⛔ RE-MEASURED ON THIS NETWORK WITH THREE NULLS, because the CHOICE OF NULL IS THE CLAIM and my first attempt used a biased one. Median distance from the nearest span:
   waygates (27)            6.32°
   any location             2.15°   ⚠️ BIASED — this network is BUILT FROM locations, so 'a random location' is guaranteed to sit near it. My first pass used this and it made waygates look ANTI-correlated at 0.43×, which would have been a false and dramatic claim.
   non-node locations       5.61°   ⛔ THE HONEST NULL: is a waygate nearer a line than another settlement is?
   uniform points          12.58°
⛔ WAYGATES vs NON-NODE SETTLEMENTS: 0.89× — INDISTINGUISHABLE. A waygate is no closer to a buried Precursor line than any other town is. ⚠️ THE THREE NETWORKS REMAIN INDEPENDENT after the rebuild, and the claim now rests on a null that cannot flatter it.
⚠️ Against uniform points both sit ~2× closer, but that says only that PEOPLE AND LINES BOTH FOLLOW THE HABITABLE BAND — not that gates follow lines.
